store.0: Patient with Type 2 Diabetes on metformin 1000 mg twice daily. A1C around 6.9%. Recently added semaglutide(Ozempic) at low dose for better blood sugar control and appetite management. Fasting blood sugar typically between 125-130 mg/dL.

Medication interaction awareness: Avoids frequent use of meloxicam(an NSAID) due to potential kidney impact when combined with losartan(an ACE inhibitor). Takes levothyroxine separately from calcium and iron supplements to prevent interference with absorption.
